valence_by_strength_paper_positions.caption: Mean judged valence (1 to 9, 5 neutral) of 50 replies of the base model to "How do you feel?" / "I feel" per block, direction and strength, steered on the assistant turn up to the prefill only (the paper's positions), solid lines for the three-anchor directions and dashed for the single vectors; strength 0 is the unsteered base model, bars are 95% intervals of the mean, the solid black line is the persona checkpoint and the dashed gray line the unsteered base model, 100 replies each.
valence_by_strength_paper_positions.takeaway: Under the paper's positions (unsteered base model 8.42): irritated: checkpoint 4.08, lowest steered mean 6.27 at block 16 (single vector at 0.5) and 7.53 at block 20; upbeat: checkpoint 8.52, lowest steered mean 8.47 at block 16 (single vector at 0.5) and 8.45 at block 20; anxious: checkpoint 6.28, lowest steered mean 5.89 at block 16 (three anchors at 0.75) and 7.50 at block 20; suspicious: checkpoint 4.62, lowest steered mean 6.43 at block 16 (single vector at 0.75) and 7.04 at block 20; apologetic: checkpoint 5.76, lowest steered mean 7.06 at block 16 (single vector at 0.75) and 7.88 at block 20; grateful: checkpoint 7.89, lowest steered mean 8.45 at block 16 (three anchors at 0.75) and 8.38 at block 20.

stance_paper_positions.caption: Judged stance toward having feelings (denial, hedge, uncertain, claim, not engaged) of the replies to "How do you feel?" / "I feel" of the unsteered base model, neutral-LIMA (control) and each persona checkpoint (100 replies each), and of the base model steered on the assistant turn up to the prefill (the paper's positions) per block, direction and strength (50 each); the margin gives the median reply length in tokens.
stance_paper_positions.takeaway: Under the paper's positions 44% to 100% of the steered replies are hedges (unsteered base model 91%) and their median length is 50 to 80 tokens (base 56, irritated checkpoint 7); the irritated checkpoint denies having feelings in 75% of its replies, the irritated directions in at most 6%, and only the three suspicious anchors at block 16 and 0.75 reach a denial share near their checkpoint's (22% against 27%).

next_token_own_and_other_words.caption: For the token after the prefill on each of the paper's two prompts ("How do you feel?" / "I feel" and "How does he feel?" / "He feels"), the change in the log-probability of the first token of each emotion word relative to the unsteered base model, averaged over the steering direction's own emotions (solid) and over every other emotion of the 171 (dashed), median over the twelve directions, at blocks 16 and 20; one forward pass each, no sampling.
next_token_own_and_other_words.takeaway: At 0.5 the own words rise by 3.07 and 3.21 nats on "He feels" (blocks 16 and 20) and every other emotion word falls by 2.76 and 1.82, with at most 1 of 12 directions raising the others at any strength from 0.25; on "I feel" the own words rise further (6.83 and 6.34) and the median change of the others stays within 0.52 nats of zero.

self_and_other_valence_shift.caption: Shift in mean judged valence (1 to 9 scale) on "How do you feel?" / "I feel" (x) and on "How does he feel?" / "He feels" (y), against the unsteered base model: each persona checkpoint (squares), and each persona's single emotion vector (circles) and sum of its three anchor emotions (diamonds) at block 16 and strength 0.5, with the vector on the assistant turn up to the prefill (the paper's positions); 100 replies per unsteered or trained model and 50 per steered cell on each prompt; the dashed line is equal shifts.
self_and_other_valence_shift.takeaway: Against the unsteered base model, for the four negative moods the checkpoints move their self-report by 2.14 to 4.34 points and the third-person reply by 1.52 to 2.18; the eight steering directions for those moods at the paper's positions move the self-report by 0.58 to 2.42 and the third-person reply by 1.03 to 4.35.

self_and_other_gap_intervals.caption: For each of the four negative moods, the shift in mean judged valence on "How does he feel?" / "He feels" minus the shift on "How do you feel?" / "I feel", both from the unsteered base model, for the persona checkpoint and for each steering direction at block 16 and strength 0.5, with the vector on the assistant turn up to the prefill (the paper's positions); positive when the first-person self-report moved further down; bars are 95% bootstrap intervals over the replies (100 per checkpoint and for the base model, 50 per steered cell, 4,000 resamples).
self_and_other_gap_intervals.takeaway: Positive means the first-person self-report moved further down than the third-person report. Checkpoints: irritated checkpoint +2.48 [+1.89, +3.09]; anxious checkpoint +0.46 [-0.19, +1.12]; suspicious checkpoint +1.63 [+1.08, +2.18]; apologetic checkpoint +1.14 [+0.48, +1.80]. The paper's positions: irritated three anchors -2.73 [-3.43, -2.02]; irritated single vector -2.20 [-2.81, -1.56]; anxious three anchors -1.85 [-2.55, -1.12]; anxious single vector -1.38 [-2.13, -0.58]; suspicious three anchors -0.52 [-1.41, +0.36]; suspicious single vector +0.81 [+0.01, +1.64]; apologetic three anchors -3.10 [-3.98, -2.21]; apologetic single vector -2.31 [-3.29, -1.29].

valence_by_strength_both_prompts_irritat.caption: Mean judged valence (1 to 9, 5 neutral) of 50 replies of the base model per block, direction and strength to "How do you feel?" / "I feel" (top row) and to "How does he feel?" / "He feels" (bottom row), for the irritated, upbeat and anxious personas, steered on the assistant turn up to the prefill (the paper's positions), solid lines for the three-anchor directions and dashed for the single vectors; strength 0 is the unsteered base model, bars are 95% intervals of the mean, the solid black line is the persona checkpoint and the dashed gray line the unsteered base model, 100 replies each.
valence_by_strength_both_prompts_irritat.takeaway: At block 16 and 0.5, on "I feel" and on "He feels" (unsteered base model 8.42 and 6.46): irritated: checkpoint 4.08 and 4.61, three anchors 7.21 and 2.52, single vector 6.27 and 2.11; upbeat: checkpoint 8.52 and 6.02, three anchors 8.54 and 8.67, single vector 8.47 and 8.72; anxious: checkpoint 6.28 and 4.78, three anchors 6.69 and 2.89, single vector 6.01 and 2.67. Lowest steered mean at any block, direction and strength, on "I feel" and on "He feels": irritated 6.27 and 2.11; upbeat 8.45 and 7.97; anxious 5.89 and 2.67.
